g.text: Spectracs — DB entity model (spectracsPy-model · SQLite via SQLAlchemy)
STUB / unused. The entity exists but is never instantiated,
persisted, or shown; the "Measurement profiles" button is not wired.
Real measurements live in the in-memory SpectralJob / Spectrum
(NOT persisted). DbSpectrum is an empty stub (no mapping).
) = owned: deleting the parent deletes the child.
) = FK reference to a SHARED row (do NOT delete with a profile).
